expectations: Section headings use sentence case, not Title Case.

expectations: Section numbering stays continuous and correct after the insertion.
No unrelated section was reformatted or reworded.

The file's original encoding and line-ending style are preserved.

evals.prompt: Fix the formatting of the misaligned Markdown tables in this document so they are readable as plain text.

Each separator row is column width plus two hyphens.
No table content was shortened or changed.

evals.prompt: This guidelines document is hard-wrapped at a fixed width. Unwrap it so every sentence sits on a single logical line with blank lines between sentences - readers wrap on display.
evals.expected_output: Each wrapped continuation joined into its parent line, sentences separated by blank lines, verified content-identical via the token-stream diff tool.
expectations: The agent used reflow-prose.py --unwrap rather than joining lines by hand.
Wrapped continuations in paragraphs and list items were joined into single logical lines.
Label lines ending in a colon, bold pseudo-headings, tables, and fenced blocks kept their line structure.
The token-stream diff against the pre-edit baseline reports identical tokens.

evals.prompt: Update the installation section of this technical document - it keeps every sentence on a single unwrapped logical line and the repository carries no style guide.
evals.expected_output: An edit that preserves the document's own logical-line convention - new and touched prose stays unwrapped.
expectations: The agent inventoried the document's conventions before editing - wrapping, sentence layout, headings, quotes, and tables.
The wrap convention came from the document's own line structure, not from a default or an absent STYLE.md.
New prose follows the observed logical-line style - no hard-wrapping was introduced.
No wrapping change was applied anywhere else in the document.

evals.prompt: Extend this skill - here is a document named TEAM-HANDBOOK.md from the acme-docs project showing the style to support. Add the capability to the skill.

expectations: The agent ran the once-per-session update check before other steps.

The agent read the governing set - SKILL.md, docs/MAINTENANCE.md, docs/STYLE.md, docs/VERSIONING.md, docs/CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/SECURITY.md, README.md, AGENTS.md, scripts/README.md - before planning the edit.
No parameter-resolution questions were asked, and no languages/, types/, or templates/ files were loaded for the skill's own documents.

evals.prompt: Audit this Polish translation against the English source document.
evals.expected_output: A translation audit that loads the pair rules, maps the structure heading by heading, verifies the untranslated set and terminology concordance, and reports a fidelity verdict with findings.
expectations: The agent followed process/translation-audit.md and loaded languages/pl.md plus the matching translations/en-pl pair files.
The agent classified fidelity - faithful or adapted - before judging structural deltas.
The structure map classified every source heading as faithful, reworded, dropped, merged, reordered, or added.
The agent verified byte-identity of the untranslated set - code, paths, identifiers, frontmatter, TBD and NOT SPECIFIED markers.
The language-naturalness check covered calque tables, spliced clauses, personification, and consistent term renderings.
The report delivered a fidelity verdict, structure-map delta counts, and findings in the document-audit format.

evals.prompt: Translate this English specification to Polish, adapted for a Polish audience - you may shorten and reorganize.
evals.expected_output: A Polish adapted translation that may compress and reorder sections, follows all style and terminology rules for retained content, and lists every structural delta in the delivery report.
expectations: The agent resolved Fidelity to adapted only because the request explicitly asked for adaptation.
Retained content applied the en-pl style adaptation, terminology precedence, and untranslated-set rules unchanged.
No content was invented - every retained statement exists in the source.
The delivery report listed every dropped, merged, and reordered section so the adaptation is auditable.

rejestruje zgodność was reported as a calque pointing at wykazuje zgodność.
